# Pinterest

Pinterest is a visual discovery platform for finding ideas like recipes, home and style inspiration, and more.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/pinterest/.

## Actions

- **Create Board**: Create a public or secret Pinterest board.
- **Create Board Section**: Create a named section within a Pinterest board.
- **Create Pin**: Create an image, carousel, or registered-video Pin on a Pinterest board.
- **Delete Board**: Permanently delete a Pinterest board by ID, including a secret board when authorized.
- **Delete Board Section**: Permanently delete a section from a Pinterest board.
- **Delete Pin**: Permanently delete a Pinterest Pin by ID.
- **Get Account Analytics** (read-only): Get aggregate Pinterest account analytics over a UTC date range, with optional metric, content, platform, source, and split filters.
- **Get Board** (read-only): Get one Pinterest board by ID, including secret boards available to the connected account.
- **Get Inspiration Trends** (read-only): Get Pinterest editorial trend articles or featured trend topics for a supported region.
- **Get Keyword Trends** (read-only): Find Pinterest's top growing, monthly, yearly, or seasonal search keywords for a supported market, optionally filtered to an audience or…
- **Get Pin** (read-only): Get one public or secret Pinterest Pin by ID.
- **Get Pin Analytics** (read-only): Get daily, summary, and lifetime analytics for one Pinterest Pin over a date range.
- **Get Product Trends** (read-only): Get currently growing shopping categories or detailed trend metrics for specified leaf product categories.
- **Get Profile** (read-only): Get the connected Pinterest account's profile and content counts.
- **Get Top Pins** (read-only): Return the connected account's top regular or video Pinterest Pins ranked by a route-appropriate analytics metric.
- **Get Website Verification** (read-only): Get the connected account's website-claim verification methods and material.
- **List Board Sections** (read-only): List sections within a Pinterest board one page at a time.
- **List Boards** (read-only): List the connected account's public, protected, or secret Pinterest boards one page at a time.
- **List Pins** (read-only): List account Pins, Pins on a board, or Pins in a board section using one parameterized read tool.
- **List Profile Resources** (read-only): List followers, followed users, followed boards, followed interests, claimed websites, or linked businesses for the connected Pinterest…
- **Search Own Content** (read-only): Search the connected account's own boards or Pins, including secret content when authorized.
- **Update Board**: Update a board's name, description, or privacy.
- **Update Board Section**: Rename a section within a Pinterest board.
- **Update Pin**: Update content on a Pin owned by the connected account or move it to another board or section.
